title: Updated taxonomy for the 2027 risk assessment data collection

paras.text: As part of its reporting framework release 4.3, the European Banking Authority (EBA) has published an updated version of the data model and taxonomy that will support the collection of data for AMLA's risk assessment of entities eligible for direct supervision.

The components in v4.3 are intended only to help reporting agents prepare for the AMLA risk assessment 2027 data collection exercise. They must not be used for submissions to national competent authorities, the EBA, or AMLA.
Please access the reporting framework v4.3 on the EBA website .

A further release , v4.4 , will follow with a revised version of these templates, drawing on the experience of the 2026 data collection to support 2027 submissions. It will update the existing package in two ways:
to better capture cases where information is not available, distinguishing them from a reported value of zero;
